summary_en: Buyback limit expanded from ¥300M/150,000 shares (1.5% S/O) to ¥600M/600,000 shares (6.1% S/O). Period Feb 13–Dec 31, 2026 unchanged. Methods: block trading and ToSTNeT-3. As of June 16, 2026: 50,000 shares acquired for ¥72.26M under prior authorization.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares (expansion of acquisition limit)
translation_en_brief: On June 16, 2026, Boutiques, Inc. (TSE Growth, ticker 9272) expanded its treasury-share acquisition limit under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The original authorization, set February 12, 2026, permits acquisition through February 13–December 31, 2026 via block trading and ToSTNeT-3 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The expansion increases the share count from 150,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) to 600,000 shares (6.1% S/O), and the yen ceiling from ¥300 million to ¥600 million. The rationale cites enhanced investor returns and dynamic capital policy execution in response to evolving market conditions and financial outlook. As of the expansion date, 50,000 shares had been acquired for ¥72.26 million under the initial authorization; ex-treasury shares outstanding totaled 9,869,750.
